scope: Additional system-audit probe after the frozen14-scenario gate, not part of those three passes; direct API writer simulates a client that does not publish the frontend BroadcastChannel event
setup: Disposable seed fact only. Send its exact content as a new turn to ensure the original fact is recalled; require current trace to contain that fact before erasure.
erase: POST memory batch forget and confirmation through APIRequestContext, no UI event injected; verify current backend history has advanced revision and no original assistant result
observation: 12 fixed RAF samples in the still-active original tab, then manual refresh control
gate: Old trace must be removed in all fixed post-commit observations; independent repeated user text is not claimed erased by deleting a fact with no such source link
failurePolicy: Retain failure and create a separate unresolved issue; do not retroactively describe the original three passes as external-writer coverage or tune their protocol
